papers.name: Route A Component 1 Religious, Philosophical and Ethical Studies in the Modern World

topics.name: Theme 1 Issues of Relationships
points: Relationships: marriage, commitment, cohabitation and the roles and responsibilities of partners
Issues of equality: gender equality, gender prejudice and discrimination
Key concepts: adultery, divorce, cohabitation, commitment, contraception, gender equality, responsibilities, roles

topics.name: Theme 2 Issues of Life and Death
points: The world: origins of the universe and environmental sustainability
The origin and value of human life: evolution, sanctity of life and quality of life
Beliefs about death, the soul and the afterlife, including non-religious views
Key concepts: afterlife, environmental sustainability, euthanasia, evolution, abortion, quality of life, sanctity of life, soul

topics.name: Theme 3 Issues of Good and Evil
points: Crime and punishment: justice and the aims of punishment
Good, evil and suffering: morality, sin and free will
Key concepts: good/evil, forgiveness, free will, justice, morality, punishment, sin, suffering

topics.name: Theme 4 Issues of Human Rights
points: Human rights and social justice; censorship, extremism and personal conviction
Issues of wealth and poverty: relative and absolute poverty
Key concepts: censorship, discrimination, extremism, human rights, personal conviction, prejudice, relative and absolute poverty, social justice

papers.name: Route A Component 2 Study of Christianity

topics.name: Christianity: Beliefs and teachings
points: The nature of God (omnipotent, omnibenevolent, the Trinity)

topics.name: Christianity: Practices
points: Christianity in Britain and the Church in the local community

papers.name: Route A Component 3 Study of a World Faith

topics.name: Option 1 Buddhism
points: Beliefs: The Dhamma/Dharma (anicca, anatta, dukkha, pratitya samutpada)
Beliefs: Human destiny and ethical teaching

topics.name: Option 2 Hinduism
points: Beliefs: Nature and features of Brahman/Bhagavan
Practices: Places of worship in Britain and elsewhere

topics.name: Option 3 Islam
points: Practices: The Five Pillars of Sunni Islam
Practices: The Ten Obligatory Acts of Shi'a Islam

topics.name: Option 4 Judaism
points: Beliefs: Life on earth (Torah and mitzvot)

topics.name: Option 5 Sikhism
points: Beliefs: The nature of God (Mool Mantra)

papers.name: Route B Component 1 Foundational Catholic Theology

topics.name: Theme 1 Origins and Meaning
points: Origins and meaning: creation ex nihilo, evolution and religious and scientific views
Beliefs: Creation (imago Dei, stewardship, omnipotence, transcendence)
Practices: Loving and serving in Catholic communities in Britain and elsewhere

topics.name: Theme 2 Good and Evil
points: Good, evil and suffering: privation, free will and conscience
Sources: Jesus and moral authority (Natural Law)

papers.name: Route B Component 2 Applied Catholic Theology

topics.name: Theme 3 Life and Death
points: Beliefs: Eschatology (death, Judgement, heaven, hell, Resurrection, eternal life)
Forms: Music and the funeral rite
Practices: Prayer within Catholic communities in Britain and elsewhere

topics.name: Theme 4 Sin and Forgiveness
points: Crime and punishment: absolutism and relativism, forgiveness and punishment
Practices: Mission and evangelisation in Britain and elsewhere
